contract_tests: tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_invalid_signature_out_of_range_timestamp_raises_bad_time_signature - asserts TimestampSigner.unsign raises BadTimeSignature (not ValueError) for an invalid signature whose decoded timestamp is outside datetime's supported year range.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_invalid_signature_out_of_range_timestamp_payload - asserts the raised BadTimeSignature.payload equals the original payload bytes passed to unsign.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_invalid_signature_out_of_range_timestamp_date_signed_none - asserts the raised BadTimeSignature.date_signed is None for the malformed timestamp.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_valid_roundtrip_returns_payload_and_date_signed - asserts sign then unsign(return_timestamp=True) returns the original payload bytes and a datetime date_signed.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_ordinary_invalid_signature_keeps_date_signed - asserts an ordinary invalid signature with a decodable timestamp raises BadTimeSignature with a datetime date_signed (not None).

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_expired_signature_raises_signature_expired_with_date_signed - asserts max_age expiry raises SignatureExpired with a datetime date_signed.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_regression.py::test_timed_serializer_loads_malformed_timestamp_raises_bad_signature_family - asserts TimedSerializer.loads raises a BadSignature-family exception (BadTimeSignature) for a malformed out-of-range timestamp.
patches.rationale: In TimestampSigner.unsign, the invalid-signature path calls self.timestamp_to_datetime(ts_int) which can raise ValueError/OverflowError/OSError when the decoded timestamp is outside datetime's supported year range. Wrap that conversion so malformed timestamps on the invalid-signature path raise BadTimeSignature with the original payload and date_signed=None, while preserving valid roundtrips, ordinary invalid-signature date_signed metadata, expiry behavior, and the TimedSerializer BadSignature-family contract.
